title: A suite test plants an invented identifier in a lookup_eval-sourced pool row and asserts pool check's unstated-names warning
goal: identifier_of in _tools/bench_pool.py judges the identifier inside a check alternative written as (?i)Name, (Name|Other) or Name(?:s)?, so pool check warns of an invented name in those forms as it does of the bare one; _tools/test_bench.py holds a test, within the suite's tests ceiling, that plants an invented identifier in a fixture pool row built on a lookup_eval.csv case and asserts pool check prints the unstated-names warning with exit 0; that test also asserts a hand-written near-miss row naming an identifier absent from the fixture kb is not flagged (BG-fl4sg2py gate g2)

run: import sys,json;sys.path.insert(0,"_tools");import bench_pool as b;r=next(x for x in b.read_csv(b.PUBLIC_FILE) if x["kind"]=="fact" and x["source"].startswith("lookup_eval.csv:"));F=["(?i)Invoke-ZzqxInventedDrift","(Invoke-ZzqxInventedDrift|Get-Zzqx)","Invoke-ZzqxInventedDrift(?:s)?","Invoke-ZzqxInventedDrift"];miss=[f for f in F if not b.unstated_names([dict(r,checks=json.dumps([f]))])];print(miss);sys.exit(1 if miss else 0)
import sys;t=open("_tools/test_bench.py",encoding="utf-8").read();sys.exit(0 if "found in no article or data file" in t else 1)
